credits.title: K-POP: The Debut
credits.overview: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her, but when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

credits.title: Waikiki
credits.overview: When a hula dancer on the run crashes into a broken spirit of a man, they begin a journey into a hidden world, developing a connection through humanity, nature, and culture.

credits.title: Seoul Searching
credits.overview: In the 1980s a group of foreign-born Korean teenagers who meet at a Seoul summer camp to learn what it means to be Korean. The three boys, from the U.S., Mexico, and Germany, then meet three girls who rock their world.

credits.title: Battle of the Year
credits.overview: A down-on-his-luck coach is hired to prepare a team of the best American dancers for an international tournament that attracts all the best crews from around the world, but the Americans haven't won in fifteen years.

credits.title: Planet B-Boy
credits.overview: Think breakdancing died in the eighties? Think again. PLANET B-BOY is a feature-length, theatrical documentary that re-discovers one of the most incredible dance phenomena the world has ever seen. credits.title: Miss Monday
credits.overview: A writer suffering a block decides to watch a young woman as a role model for his novel, but finds more than he bargained for.
